integrity: Proof analytically reconstructs exact stages and all moment boundaries. Standalone finite exact-arithmetic verifier is supplementary evidence, not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Scalar two-point iid curvature, same sample across all stages, undamped SRKCD, fixed aggressive macrostep, exact arithmetic; no nonlinear or finite-precision guarantee. The theorem complements rather than refutes worst-case curvature stability guarantees.
title: Sharp rare-curvature stability and extinction frontiers for stochastic Chebyshev descent
